d: Short, messy plum-purple hair with jagged bangs and a youthful, mature face with sharp, almond-shaped plum-purple eyes. A lean build dressed in a layered white and charcoal-grey tunic with gold trim, a high black collar, a white capelet, and dark charcoal trousers tucked into matching boots. Accessories include a brown leather utility belt, a side-slung brown pouch containing glowing green vials, dark blue gloves, and a staff topped with a glowing green orb.
